title: Strings that impersonate JSON literals stay strings, and stay distinct from the literals
rationale: The default reconstruction path must never type-infer. This is the good-input arm of the family and the discrimination test for the scalar domain: the same document carries the string "true" beside the boolean true and the string "1" beside the number 1. It also pins the string arm of the known NaN/Infinity collapse: when that DEFECT is fixed by tagging non-finite doubles, the genuine string "NaN" must NOT acquire the tag.
catchesBugClass: Silent type inference on the default reconstruction path; a non-finite-value fix that over-reaches and captures genuine text; any change that collapses empty string into null at the scalar level.
cannotCatch: Says nothing about the delimiter formats, where these exact strings ARE coerced by parseAtomicValue. It also cannot catch loss that only appears at array arity >= 2, and with a class-blind oracle it would pass even if 1 silently widened to 1.0.

predicted.detail: Every value is a String, Boolean or Number that normalizePrimitive returns unchanged. No value promotes the wrap prefix to an array path.
